summary: Frontend-only verification that the Google Tag (GT-PLHLCK7D + AW-18460200148) is route-gated to /consulting ONLY. Executed with page.route aborting ALL Google domains (googletagmanager.com, google-analytics.com, analytics.google.com, doubleclick.net, googleadservices.com, google.com/ccm, google.com/pagead) — zero hits delivered to the user's Google Ads account. Verified via DOM + window.dataLayer only. Preview host blubridge-setup.preview.emergentagent.com is TEMP allowlisted (REACT_APP_GOOGLE_TAG_ALLOWED_HOSTS) so the module boots. Results: (1) curl HTML on /, /consulting, /contact, /careers, /admin has ZERO occurrences of 'googletagmanager', 'gtag(' and 'window.dataLayer' — tag is never inline. (2) Direct /consulting -> window.gtag is function, exactly one <script src='…/gtag/js?id=GT-PLHLCK7D' data-testid='google-tag-script'>, dataLayer has configs ['config','GT-PLHLCK7D',{send_page_view:false}] AND ['config','AW-18460200148',{send_page_view:false}] and exactly one page_view with page_path='/consulting' and non-empty page_title ('AI Consulting Services | Tailored AI Systems | BluBridge'). /consulting/ (trailing) and /Consulting (case) also boot the tag (isTrackedPath normalises). (3) Direct loads of /, /contact, /careers, /about-us, /consulting-9, /consulting-12, /careers/job/data-science-ai-ml-engineer: typeof window.gtag==='undefined', typeof window.dataLayer==='undefined', 0 googletagmanager scripts, no console errors other than deliberate net::ERR_FAILED from our abort. (4) SPA: load / (untracked) -> click nav-contact-cta -> /contact still untracked -> pushState('/consulting') + popstate -> module boots (1 loader, 2 configs, 1 page_view '/consulting'). On /consulting click nav-contact-cta: a 'click' event with link_type 'cta' is pushed and the route changes to /contact with NO page_view for /contact. On /contact, clicks on linkedin and mailto do NOT add click events (listener detached off-route; click count 1->1). Back to /consulting -> second page_view '/consulting' pushed, scripts count still 1 (no duplicate boot). (5) Click rules on /consulting: footer LinkedIn link produced ['event','click',{link_type:'outbound', link_domain:'www.linkedin.com', link_url:'https://www.linkedin.com/company/blubridge/', ...}]; footer privacy-policy link produced NO click event. (6) generate_lead: /api/ai-consulting-enquiries and /api/contacts/submit mocked (201) via page.route; dispatched FORM_SUCCESS_EVENT with path='/api/ai-consulting-enquiries' on /consulting -> dataLayer gained exactly ['event','generate_lead',{form_name:'ai_consulting', page_path:'/consulting'}] and NO 'conversion' event (label unset — expected). Navigated to /contact and dispatched FORM_SUCCESS_EVENT with path='/api/contacts/submit' -> NO generate_lead event (listeners detached). (7) Admin: direct /admin has no gtag/dataLayer/scripts; admin-login-submit renders. From /consulting pushState('/admin') -> location.pathname=='/admin', gtag/dataLayer undefined, admin-login-submit present (admin boundary strips tag). (8) Regression at 1920x800 and 390x844: /consulting, /, /contact, /careers all return 200 with header + footer; no pageerror; GET /api/form-context returns 200 application/json on /consulting. Total intercepted Google requests over entire run: 6 (all aborted; zero reached Google).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/analytics/googleTag.js: isTrackedPath normalises trailing slash + lowercases, uses envList from REACT_APP_GOOGLE_TAG_ROUTES — exact-match semantics confirmed (/, /contact, /consulting-9, /consulting-12 all evaluate to false; /consulting, /consulting/, /Consulting evaluate to true). isAdminPath short-circuits before the match (admin never tracked).

frontend/src/analytics/GoogleTagTracker.jsx: both effects are keyed on `tracked` so listeners (document click + bb:form-success) attach only while tracked and detach on route change — verified behaviourally: 0 click events pushed on /contact after leaving /consulting, 0 generate_lead events pushed on /contact. page_view timer uses setTimeout(0) which lets AiConsulting apply its document.title before capture (observed non-empty page_title).
loadGoogleTag() is idempotent via window.__bbGoogleTag — SPA pushState->popstate->/consulting twice resulted in exactly 1 script[data-testid='google-tag-script'] but 2 page_view events, as spec'd.

clickTracking.js: internal non-CTA footer links are correctly ignored (privacy-policy link produced no event); outbound (linkedin) correctly tagged link_type='outbound'; CTA (nav-contact-cta, class 'bb-btn-primary') produced link_type='cta' with page_path captured at click time (= '/consulting').

leadTracking.js: '/api/ai-consulting-enquiries' maps to form_name 'ai_consulting' (verified via dispatched FORM_SUCCESS_EVENT). Note: this mapping relies on the production bb:form-success event being dispatched after a REAL 2xx response from POST /api/ai-consulting-enquiries. The UI submit path was not E2E-exercised in this run (per spec, mocked). Main agent has previously verified the full form flow; the handler contract is now green on both ends.
conversionSendTo returns null while REACT_APP_GOOGLE_ADS_CONVERSION_LABEL is empty — observed zero 'conversion' events, matching spec until the label is configured.
Minor nit (not a bug): isAllowedHost does not strip port from location.hostname; browsers never put port there — safe. Documenting.
test_credentials: admin login not testable (ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD absent); only verified login page renders untagged.
seed_data_creation: None. /api/ai-consulting-enquiries and /api/contacts/submit POSTs mocked via Playwright page.route (status 201). Google traffic aborted via page.route (0 live hits). No live DB records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route-gated Google tag is working end-to-end: boots ONLY on /consulting (including /consulting/ and /Consulting), silent elsewhere, listeners detach off-route, idempotent loader, generate_lead fires only for ai_consulting on /consulting, admin boundary strips tag. If main agent toggles the allowlist, re-run: (a) curl 5 routes for googletagmanager/gtag(/dataLayer; (b) browser direct-load /consulting while aborting Google domains -> verify 1 loader + 2 configs + 1 page_view; (c) direct-load /, /contact, /careers, /about-us, /consulting-9/-12, /careers/job/... -> verify typeof window.gtag==='undefined'; (d) SPA pushState('/consulting') twice -> loader count stays 1 but page_view count grows to 2; (e) dispatch bb:form-success CustomEvent with detail.path '/api/ai-consulting-enquiries' on /consulting (lead fires) and on /contact (no lead); (f) /admin direct + pushState from /consulting -> no gtag/dataLayer. Known pre-existing /about-us mobile overflow intentionally not reported. The AiConsulting form is complex (ContactDetails + ProjectDetails + ServiceSelection + CountrySelect); testing the generate_lead event via FORM_SUCCESS_EVENT dispatch is deterministic and exercises the same code path as a real submit (describeFormSuccess -> trackEvent).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Implementation matches spec exactly across all 8 verification clauses in the review request.
